candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition from greater-than to greater-than-or-equal, so block.timestamp == pastBlockTime passes.
Change the divisor in the ether-transfer condition from 15 to another number (e.g., 16), altering which block numbers trigger transfer.
Remove the update of pastBlockTime so the time gate never advances after the first call.
Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to a different amount, altering call validity.
